reasoning: The agent went beyond a bare import/run check — it spot-checked determinism (level 3) and made a real, if failed, attempt to build a JAX-weight-transfer parity harness and pull the JAX reference loss (steps 79-83). This sits above the level-3 spot-check but short of the level-5 anchor's completed end-to-end parity comparison plus optimized-vs-model.py check, landing at 4.
